items.colloc: leave a voicemail 留下語音訊息 | check voicemail 查詢語音訊息
items.distinct: message 訊息 | memo 備忘錄
ex: Please leave your message after the tone.
請在提示音後留下語音訊息。
I sent him a voicemail this morning.
我今天早上傳了語音訊息給他。
He checked his voicemail during the break.
他在休息時間查看了語音信箱。

items.colloc: switchboard operator 總機接線生 | talk to the operator 與接線生通話
items.distinct: receptionist 接待員 | agent 代理人
ex: The operator will connect your call shortly.
接線生稍後會為您轉接電話。
I asked the operator for a directory.
我向接線生索取電話號碼簿。
She works as an operator at headquarters.
她在總部擔任接線生。

items.colloc: inquire about the status 詢問狀況 | formally inquire 正式詢問
items.distinct: require 需要 | acquire 獲得
ex: We wish to inquire about your services.
我們希望能詢問關於貴方的服務。
She inquired about the meeting location.
她詢問了關於會議的地點。
Clients often inquire about shipping costs.
客戶常詢問關於運費的事宜。

items.colloc: forward an email 轉寄郵件 | forward a call 轉接電話
items.distinct: postpone 延後 | send 發送
ex: Please forward the report to my assistant.
請將報告轉寄給我的助理。
The system will forward all your calls.
系統將會自動轉接您所有的電話。
I have forwarded the inquiry to HR.
我已經將該詢問轉發給人資部。

items.colloc: notify someone of something 通知某人某事 | promptly notify 立即通知
items.distinct: inform 告知 | announce 宣佈
ex: The manager will notify us by email.
經理將會透過電子郵件通知我們。
Please notify the staff about the change.
請告知員工關於此項變動。
We were notified of the sudden delay.
我們被通知了關於突然的延誤。

items.colloc: business correspondence 商務通信 | handle correspondence 處理信件
items.distinct: communication 溝通 | document 文件
ex: Please file all the business correspondence.
請將所有的商務信件歸檔。
She handles all the company correspondence.
她處理所有的公司往來信件。
The correspondence was lost in transit.
那封信件在運送過程中遺失了。

items.pos: adj. 簡短的 | v. 向...簡報
items.colloc: a brief meeting 簡短會議 | brief the team 向團隊簡報
items.distinct: short 短的 | quick 快速的
ex: The director briefed us on the plan.
總監向我們簡報了該計畫。
They held a brief meeting this morning.
他們今天早上舉行了簡短會議。
I will brief you after the call.
電話結束後我會向你說明。

items.colloc: interrupt the conversation 中斷對話 | sorry to interrupt 抱歉打斷
items.distinct: interfere 干擾 | disrupt 擾亂
ex: I am sorry to interrupt your call.
抱歉打斷了你的通話。
The bad connection interrupted the meeting.
糟糕的通訊中斷了會議。
Please do not interrupt during the presentation.
簡報期間請勿打斷發言。

items.colloc: convey a message 傳達訊息 | convey information 傳達資訊
items.distinct: deliver 遞送 | connect 連接
ex: Please convey my apologies to the team.
請代我向團隊致歉。
The note conveys a very clear message.
那張紙條傳達了很明確的訊息。
He failed to convey his ideas clearly.
他沒能清楚傳達他的想法。

items.pos: adj. 無法取得的；沒空的
items.colloc: currently unavailable 目前無法接聽 | unavailable for comment 無法評論
items.distinct: available 可用的 | accessible 可進入的
ex: The manager is unavailable at the moment.
經理目前不方便接聽。
This product is unavailable in our branch.
這項產品在我們分店沒貨。
He is unavailable for a meeting today.
他今天無法參加會議。

items.colloc: company directory 公司通訊錄 | look up the directory 查詢目錄
items.distinct: dictionary 字典 | diary 日記
ex: I checked the company directory for his name.
我查閱公司通訊錄找他的名字。
Please add your number to the directory.
請將你的號碼加入通訊錄。
You can find the extension in the directory.
你可以在目錄中找到分機。

items.colloc: email attachment 電子郵件附件 | open the attachment 開啟附件
items.distinct: attraction 吸引力 | achievement 成就
ex: Did you receive the file attachment?
你有收到那個檔案附件嗎？
The attachment contains the project details.
附件中包含專案的細節。
Please check the attachment for more info.
請查看附件以獲取更多資訊。

items.pos: v. 張貼；郵寄 | n. 職位
items.colloc: post an announcement 張貼公告 | post the letter 郵寄信件
items.distinct: past 過去的 | host 主辦
ex: I will post the new schedule online.
我會將新行程表貼在網路上。
Please post the invoice by tomorrow.
請在明天之前寄出那張發票。
They posted the vacancy on the website.
他們在網站上張貼了職缺資訊。

items.colloc: verbal agreement 口頭協議 | verbal confirmation 口頭確認
items.distinct: vocal 嗓音的 | written 書面的
ex: We reached a verbal agreement yesterday.
我們昨天達成了口頭協議。
Please provide a written, not verbal, notice.
請提供書面而非口頭的通知。
She gave a verbal report to the director.
她對總監做了口頭報告。

items.colloc: regarding the matter 關於此事 | regarding your inquiry 關於您的詢問
items.distinct: regardless 不管 | recording 紀錄
ex: I am calling regarding the order status.
我致電是為了詢問訂單狀況。
They have questions regarding the new policy.
他們對於新政策有一些問題。
Regarding your email, we need more time.
關於您的郵件，我們需要更多時間。

items.pos: n. 格式 | v. 格式化
items.colloc: file format 檔案格式 | follow the format 遵循格式
items.distinct: form 表格 | formula 公式
ex: Please use the standard report format.
請使用標準的報告格式。
The file format is not compatible here.
這檔案格式在此不相容。
He changed the format of the document.
他更改了文件的格式。

items.colloc: sudden hangup 突然掛斷 | avoid a hangup 避免故障
items.distinct: hiccup 小問題 | breakdown 故障
ex: The call ended with a sudden hangup.
這通電話在突然掛斷中結束。
He experienced a hangup during the call.
他在通話過程中遇到障礙。
There was a hangup in our communication.
我們的溝通出現了障礙。

items.colloc: host a teleconference 舉辦遠端會議 | join the teleconference 參加遠端會議
items.distinct: videoconference 視訊會議 | seminar 研討會
ex: We will hold a teleconference tomorrow morning.
我們明天早上將召開遠端會議。
Please prepare for the upcoming teleconference.
請為即將到來的遠端會議做準備。
All managers should join the teleconference.
所有經理都應該參加遠端會議。

items.colloc: intercept a call 接聽來電 | intercept information 截獲資訊
items.distinct: interrupt 中斷 | interfere 干擾
ex: I will intercept the call for you.
我會幫你接聽這通電話。
Did you intercept the urgent message?
你有攔截到那則緊急訊息嗎？
The secretary had to intercept his calls.
秘書必須協助攔截他的來電。

items.pos: adj. 無法到達的；難以聯繫的
items.zh: 無法到達的；難以聯繫的
items.colloc: remain inaccessible 保持無法聯繫 | inaccessible area 難以進入區域
items.distinct: inadmissible 不可採納的 | unreachable 達不到的
ex: The manager is currently inaccessible by phone.
經理目前電話無法聯繫上。
That file is inaccessible to most employees.
大多數員工無法存取該檔案。
He remained inaccessible throughout the busy day.
他在忙碌的一整天都無法聯繫。
